_comment: Trust policy for role empverify-github-deploy (IAM > Roles > empverify-github-deploy > Trust relationships > Edit trust policy). Mirrors infra/terraform/bootstrap/main.tf. Trusts BOTH GitHub OIDC subject forms: the classic owner/repo one, and the immutable owner@id/repo@id one GitHub switched this repository to - the switch is what broke CI deploys with 'Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity'.
